purpose: Final bounded follow-up of the two previously unclassified video timing differences

method.captureInteraction: First consent button, then existing production Popup re-identify button
method.popupPresentation: Frozen popup.html opened in a browser tab; not a Stable Chrome toolbar Popup or native window-size acceptance.
method.observation: Read-only HTML/DOM sampling brackets the actual capture request. Brackets are not an atomic DOM snapshot; differing brackets remain ambiguous.
method.offline: Only SHA-verified frozen ProductSpy content.js is evaluated, in JSDOM outside-only. Amazon page scripts are never evaluated and no resources are loaded.
method.feesAndPersistence: Zero AI calls, zero library saves, zero explicit media download/API checks
method.challengePolicy: Stop this host after the first verification page; never retry navigation
